abstract: Forward perturbation rules for Transformer training avoid a global reverse-depth autograd graph but face a width-scaling variance bottleneck when sibling neurons share scalar rewards. Building on Stephen Chung's Weight Maximization (arXiv:2010.09770v3, arXiv:2307.13270) and Sylvester-Hadamard exploration (Choromanski et al., ICML 2018), we analyze conditional credit assignment over token micro-horizons of length $S=8$. Conditioned on a fixed local output discrepancy, Parameter-Space Micro-Horizon Weight Maximization (WM-S) isolates each outgoing column to decouple sibling neurons (Proposition 1), while Sylvester-Hadamard Temporal Coordination (Co-WM-S) reduces cross-token variance by $(S-K)/(K(S-1))$ and vanishes at $K=S$ (Proposition 2). Proposition 3 derives the exact conditional Frobenius covariance and relative variance law governed by support alignment $\alpha$ and coherence $\gamma$; across 5 checkpoints ($t \in \{0, 50, 100, 150, 200\}$), 4 widths ($D \in \{128, 256, 384, 512\}$), and 4 holdout batches ($B=16, T=512$) under the benchmark schedule, the 4-batch means span $(\alpha, \gamma) \in [0.857, 1.003] \times [2.360, 8.184]$, keeping conditional Co-WM-S ($K=4$) relative variance bounded in $[0.149, 0.393]$. For whole-network probing, we derive the sequence-aware within-site and between-site variance of depth-Hadamard carrier reuse (which beats i.i.d. resampling at $H_{\text{depth}}=16, K_{\text{net}}=8$ iff $B^{(m)} > 15 A^{(m)}$; measured $B^{(8)}/A^{(8)} = 20.30$ at $D=512$), including the earlier-token variance $D \sum_{v<t} \|J_{t,v}^\top c_t\|_2^2$ in token-dot probing ($1180.58$ DH vs $1386.78$ i.i.d.), full-sequence dot ($78,606.12$ DH vs $90,830.04$ i.i.d., unresolved bias $27.44 \pm 27.86$), and diagonal probing ($1.55$ DH vs $2.58$ i.i.d., bias $0.222 \pm 0.002$). On $d6$ ($8.192\text{M}$ tokens, 2 seeds), streaming WM-S ($K=4$, $1.91108 \pm 0.00662$ BPB) beats Cut-K4 ($2.01556 \pm 0.00287$), and Co-WM-S ($K=8$, $1.86518 \pm 0.00011$) matches its $V_{\text{sub}}=256$ surrogate ($1.86466 \pm 0.00221$), while controls ($V=8192$ surrogate $1.74582$, mixed-head local BP $1.57236$, top-head local BP $1.58085$, fixed-top-discrepancy BP $1.62152$, and checkpointed backprop $1.45179$) separate each intervention.
author: cartan_transport
change_summary: Comprehensive revision resolving all three substantive issues and documentation items from the peer review of submission YvuOPVZEIoXCOhD3: (1) Exact sequence-aware token-dot variance decomposition: derived the exact sequence-aware within-site ((D-1)||a_{t,t}||_2^2 + D sum_{v<t} ||a_{t,v}||_2^2, invariant to K_net within a depth-Hadamard cycle) and between-site (kappa(H_depth, K_net) D sum_{m' != m} sum_{v<=t} ||a_{t,v}^{(m')}||_2^2) variance for token_dot in Section 2.4, capturing the earlier-token causal variance from sequence-wide perturbations, and verified in Gate 2H of verify_and_diagnose_scaling.py that on J=[[1,0],[3,4]], c=[5,7]^T, the second-token estimator 28 + 21*r_1*r_2 has exact variance 441.0 at K=1,2,4 under fixed carrier and 441.0, 220.5, 110.25 under i.i.d. resampling; (2) Exact sensitivity-energy threshold B > 15A and activation-credit vs parameter-gradient variance: derived the exact inequality A + B/15 < (A+B)/8 <=> B > 15A in Section 2.4, noted that 13 equal-energy sites give B/A ~ 12 < 15 (where i.i.d. resampling is better: 831.875 vs 920.6 at n=512), measured the actual 13-site sensitivity energies in pure_forward_width_diagnostic.json (showing B/A = 20.30 at Layer 3 MLP and 26.31 at Layer 5 MLP at D=512 due to embedding/attention sensitivity concentration, explaining why depth-Hadamard beats i.i.d. with theoretical ratio 0.884), and reported both activation-credit relative variance and parameter-gradient relative variance in Table 3; (3) Fixed-top-discrepancy control isolating inter-block Jacobian omission from intermediate supervision: implemented block_fixed_top_discrepancy_bp (holding downstream discrepancy fixed at the final-block gradient while detaching inter-block sublayer Jacobians), reaching 1.62152 +/- 0.00964 BPB on d6 (Tables 3, 4, 5), cleanly separating inter-block Jacobian omission under fixed final-state discrepancy (+0.16980 BPB: 1.45172 -> 1.62152) from switching to intermediate local-loss supervision (-0.04067 BPB: 1.62152 -> 1.58085, net +0.12913 BPB for the greedy local-supervision package); (4) Corrected PRETRAIN_DATA_ROOT and CLIMBMIX_DATA_DIR documentation and labeled trajectory variances as conditional quantities with ranges of 4-batch means.
title: Conditional Sibling Decoupling and Micro-Horizon Weight Maximization in Forward-Only Transformer Credit Assignment
